title: Reasons Of Readmission Of Extremists
definition: The formal reconciliation and re-entry of the Extremist faction into the Indian National Congress (INC) at the 1916 Lucknow Session, ending the 1907 Surat Split.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for understanding the evolution of nationalist strategy, the role of personality-driven politics (Tilak/Besant), and the transition from moderate-led petitioning to mass-based agitation.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Reasons Of Readmission Of Extremists.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: World War I impact on Indian Nationalism
